Madras High Court Questions Tamil Nadu Police on RSS March Denials

The Madras High Court questioned the Tamil Nadu police on Wednesday regarding the repeated denial of permission for Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) route marches. The court asked why permission was denied every year, noting that such marches were permitted even in Jammu and Kashmir, which it described as "terrorist-infested." One report quoted the court stating, "Govt Seeing Citizens As Enemies." The court's questioning implies a challenge to the state police's consistent refusal.
